introText.en: Take Algebra 2 offline. The PDF packet prints straight from your browser; native Word versions with editable equation-editor math are available on request.

introText.en: Build a randomised test from this subject’s question bank. Pick the number of questions and a difficulty, generate, then reveal the worked answers when you’re ready — or print a clean copy to hand out.

examDescription.en: Comprehensive 90-minute Algebra II final examination: 40 multiple-choice questions across two 45-minute sections covering polynomials, complex numbers, rational/radical equations, logarithms, sequences, conics, and trigonometry.
examDescription.ar: اختبار نهائي شامل في الجبر ٢ (٩٠ دقيقة): ٤٠ سؤال اختيار من متعدد في قسمين يغطيان كثيرات الحدود والأعداد المركبة والدوال النسبية واللوغاريتمية والمتتابعات والقطوع المخروطية.
